source: Blender render of the prompt2md origami crane (the same frames as assets/crane-turntable.mp4, lossless)
rule: At frame-local time t >= t0 (the crane's entrance), show f[(floor((t - t0) * 24) mod 60) + 1]; exactly one image visible at a time.
